### Skeleton
Placeholder shapes that hold the layout while content loads.

Component ID: `skeleton`

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/skeleton.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/skeleton.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.20.0)

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `css-only`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Example: A one-second spinner while a form saves is a loading indicator. Skeletons there would draw content shapes for something that is not content.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Support: Box, text line and circle shapes with a shimmer that reverses in RTL, stops under reduced motion and keeps an outline in forced colors.

Web adaptation: Empty decorative blocks; the page marks the loading region aria-busy and reports the wait through a status.

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#skeleton).

#### Contract

A `.skeleton` is an empty block in the shape of the content it stands in for, with a shimmer passing across it. Size the default box with `width` and `height`. `text` is one line of body text, and the last of several lines runs shorter. `circle` is a 40px circle for an avatar. Reduced motion stops the shimmer and keeps the shapes. CSS only; there is no JavaScript.

Skeletons say nothing to assistive technology. Mark the region being filled with `aria-busy="true"` and report the wait in a status, such as a loading indicator or visually hidden `role="status"` text. Swap in the content and remove `aria-busy` in the same update.

#### Syntax

```html
<p class="visually-hidden" role="status">Loading messages</p>
<div class="flex gap-4" aria-busy="true">
  <div class="skeleton circle"></div>
  <div class="flex-1">
    <div class="skeleton text"></div>
    <div class="skeleton text"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

#### Also documented

The Skeleton section of the [API reference](https://www.expressivecss.com/llm.md) also covers Tokens.

#### Rules

- `skeleton-is-empty`: Keep a .skeleton empty. Text inside it is read out as if it were content; report the wait through a status such as a loading indicator, and mark the loading region aria-busy="true".
